description_en: Starts a session to log on to a Simple Application Server instance
description_zh: 为轻量应用服务器提供会话登录能力
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open start-terminal-session --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id ace0706b2ac4454d984295a942130000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartTerminalSession

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Simple Application Server instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Simple Application Server instance
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The command to run after the session is started. The command can be up to 512 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 发起会话后，指定执行的命令内容。长度不能超过 512 个字符
parameters.name: command_line

SecurityToken.description_en: The security token that is included in the request header of the WebSocket request for authentication
SecurityToken.description_zh: 附加在WebSocket的请求头部，用于系统校验本次请求

WebSocketUrl.description_en: The URL of the WebSocket session that is used to remotely connect to the Simple Application Server instance. The URL contains the session ID (`SessionId`) and the security token (`SecurityToken`) that is used for authentication
WebSocketUrl.description_zh: 远程连接轻量应用服务器实例的WebSocket会话对应的URL。包含了会话ID（`SessionId`）以及用于系统校验的`SecurityToken`
